measurementCaveats: QML statements use Date.now calibrated to perf_counter, 1 ms resolution.
Qt stage durations are Qt timers; Python message/callback entry timestamps can be perturbed by GIL and diagnostic work.
Qt render timings are CPU stage durations, not GPU execution or observable desktop presentation.
Native texture export callback span includes copy/synchronization work and cannot be split into fence/keyed-mutex sub-stages from these logs.
Native export occurs inside the recorded render stage; adding it again double counts.
Cold failed runs never reach target import or target presentation; those costs remain unmeasured.
Separate-process variants with different instrumentation, source snapshots and deliberate delays are not matched causal before/after trials.
Repeated layout-only results omit native motion and cannot qualify the fixed target transfer deadline.
Prepared endpoint comparison uses pre-prepared target and 120 ms hold; cannot establish cold speed or uninterrupted live handoff.
The first-target-frame result proves a captured frame at resized extent; layout completeness and later stability need pixel/semantic evidence.
